title: Roster
description: Roster is a standalone Paper plugin for TAB headers, nametags, sidebar display, and player-facing server branding.
body:
Roster is a standalone Paper plugin for TAB headers, nametags, sidebar display, and player-facing server branding. Designed for Paper 1.21.1+, it uses native Bukkit and Adventure APIs to provide a clean display setup without bloated core dependencies.

Documentation • Discord

--- ## Features that make Roster stand out - **Next-Gen TAB List Management**: Easily configure beautiful, animated TAB headers and footers using the modern MiniMessage format. Add gradients, HEX colors, and dynamic server stats effortlessly! - **Premium Player Nametags**: Ditch the vanilla white names. Provide clean, overhead group-based nametags with LuckPerms prefix support and automatic, weight-based team sorting so your admins always appear at the top. - **Highly Customizable Sidebar Scoreboard**: A flicker-free, fully customizable sidebar scoreboard. Support for multiple lines, conditional rendering, full PlaceholderAPI integration, and configurable interval updates. - **F3 Server Branding**: Stand out from the crowd! Override the default "Paper" text in the F3 debug menu with your own server's brand name, sent directly to the client natively. - **Intelligent Group Fallbacks**: A fully configurable internal groups system. Roster works perfectly standalone with its own groups, or seamlessly hooks into LuckPerms to automatically sync primary groups and weights! - **Seamless API Integrations**: First-class, plug-and-play support for LuckPerms and PlaceholderAPI without ever requiring them to function. Roster adapts to your server's ecosystem. - **Global Multi-Language Support**: Comes out-of-the-box with **8 built-in languages** (including English, Spanish, Polish, German, French, Russian, Chinese, and Japanese) and full support for your own custom translation files. *(Note: Built-in translations were generated using advanced AI technologies and may contain slight inaccuracies).* - **Zero Core Dependencies**: Roster doesn't require any bloated core plugins or libraries to function. Just drop it in and enjoy a beautifully branded server. ## Installation 1. Download the latest `Roster-x.x.jar`. 2. Drop it into your `plugins/` directory. 3. Ensure your server runs **Paper 1.21.1+** and **Java 21**. 4. Restart your server. Everything from permissions, commands, configuration, to format layouts is thoroughly documented on the [official documentation website](https://mc.mmaik.com/).
